fieldValues.title: Discovery-ladder list payloads gained the fields the ladder exists to surface
fieldValues.summary: type list, field list and type schema each dropped a property the discovery ladder needs, forcing a get per entity. All three were already correct one layer down (RecordType on disk, FieldSummary in the service layer, editorHint on Field) — the fix projects them the rest of the way out.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/975. `TypeSummary` (srs-repository) gains `identity_field_id`/`lifecycle_ref`, populated from the already-loaded `RecordType`; `TypeListEntry` (srs-cli payload) and its handler carry them through. `FieldListEntry` gains `fieldType`, sourced from `FieldSummary`, which already carried it whole — the CLI payload struct was the only gap. `type_schema_service::apply_editor_hint_widget` applies a Field's authored `editorHint` as an explicit override of the format-based `x-srs-widget` default, for any datatype, not just the string case the issue reported. WASM (`srs-bindings`) needed no change: `list_types`/`list_fields` already serialize the service structs directly. Golden schemas regenerated (`crates/srs-cli/schemas/payload/{type,field}-list.json`). Guard proven red: reverted `type-list.json` to its stale pre-fix golden while the struct carried the new fields; `payload_contracts` failed with a byte-diff panic naming the missing keys, then passed again once restored. New behavioral tests: `field_list_includes_field_type`, `type_list_includes_identity_field_id_and_lifecycle_ref`, `type_schema_honors_editor_hint_override`. All three gates (`cargo build/test/clippy -D warnings --workspace`) exit 0, `cargo test` run with `SRS_SPEC_DIR` pointed at a fresh `origin/master` clone per srs-rust#874/carried-context-eca39af2 (this session's own `srs` sibling sits on a designated feature branch, not master).
